name: two shores
did: Coastline is playable: the dead swim ashore, the boat ramp goes down to the water, and the map has an edge. The Blaze shoots fire and becomes a flamethrower when the rock has had it. The Arc Breaker Mark II is in the box.
onAccept: Your round is saved and the map is rebuilt. You keep your points, your guns and your perks, and the dead hold off for three minutes while you get set.
